sections.title: Identification and form
sections.text: This entry represents Matricaria chamomilla, also called M. recutita, German chamomile. This aromatic annual is usually 8–60 cm tall and grows in open places.

sections.title: Leaves and flower heads
sections.text: The foliage is finely divided. The flower heads have white rays around a yellow disc; the conical receptacle is hollow at maturity. The small dry fruits are about 0.75–0.9 mm long.

sections.title: Use and cautions
sections.text: The flower heads are used in infusions. Allergic reactions to chamomile products have been reported, sometimes severely; people allergic to Asteraceae should use caution.
